item.title: U.S. military bombs Kharg Island, Iran's main oil export hub, Trump says
item.summary: President Trump said on Friday the U.S. military had "totally obliterated" military targets in Kharg Island, home to the primary terminal that handles Iran's oil exports. This as all six crew members on a refueling plane that went down in western Iraq were confirmed dead.

item.title: These are the casualties and cost of the war in Iran 2 weeks into the conflict
item.summary: The war in Iran has already cost the U.S. billions of dollars. Here's the impact by the numbers.

item.title: With boom in prediction markets, some lawmakers worry about how to police themselves
item.summary: House and Senate ethics committees give no financial disclosure guidance on event contracts or prediction markets — unlike stock, cryptocurrency and bond trades.

item.title: Why women have an especially tough time in Senegal's prisons
item.summary: Women charged with a crime in Senegal are at the mercy of a slow judicial process and prisons that may lack basic supplies. They also face stigma that robs them of familial and community support.

item.title: The Oscars are Sunday night. Here's how to watch
item.summary: The Oscars start at 7 p.m. Eastern, 4 p.m. Pacific on Sunday, airing on ABC and streaming on Hulu.

item.title: Reframing Georgia O'Keeffe's legacy and protecting the land she loved
item.summary: Georgia O'Keeffe called the New Mexico high desert "my country," but Pueblo peoples predated her. A more complex view is emerging amid efforts to preserve the land.

item.title: Helpful or harmful? How to vet tax advice from social media
item.summary: So you heard a piece of tax advice from a friend or on social media that sounds interesting. Should you try it? A certified public accountant explains how to vet the claim — and avoid getting scammed.

item.title: Kennedy Center president departs – months before the art complex's scheduled closing
item.summary: In a post on Truth Social, President Trump announced Friday afternoon that Richard Grenell is leaving the Kennedy Center. The arts complex is scheduled to close in July for renovations.

item.title: House GOP leadership silent as more members post anti-Muslim statements
item.summary: A growing number of Republicans in Congress are embracing rhetoric against Muslims. Their remarks have faced little public pushback from leadership.

item.title: Class-action lawsuit filed after the Potomac sewage spill
item.summary: A class-action lawsuit has been filed after part of a decades-old sewer line in Maryland collapsed in January, sending raw sewage into the Potomac River. After weather delays, repair work has resumed.
